DHAKA, Nov 09, 2022 (BSS) - The government and visiting team of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) have reached a staff-level agreement to support Bangladesh's reform policies under a new 42-month ECF/EFF arrangement of about US$3.2 billion, and a concurrent RSF arrangement of about $1.3 billion.
